paite: Pathian aw, ka thumna ah bildoh inla; hehpih ka ngetna ah kisel ke'n.
heading: David La / Alawm In Akhem Mi Khat Thumna
english: For the Chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A contemplation by David. Listen to my prayer, God. Don’t hide yourself from my supplication.

paite: Hon za inla, hon dawng in; ka mangbat thu ziak in ka mau vialvial a, ka thum nilouh hi.
english: Attend to me, and answer me. I am restless in my complaint, and moan

paite: Melma husa in hon hihmangbang; migilou-salou nuaisiahna in ahon vuk ua, heh in hon sawi uhi.
english: because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked. For they bring suffering on me. In anger they hold a grudge against me.

paite: Ka sung ah ka lungtang ana mahmah a, sih mulkimnate'n hon delhkhum hi.
english: My heart is severely pained within me. The terrors of death have fallen on me.

paite: Lauthawnna leh linna in hon bawm a, launa in ahon khuh khinta hi.
english: Fearfulness and trembling have come on me. Horror has overwhelmed me.

paite: Huan ke'n, vakhu bang a kha neih ut hi na tel ing e, aw! Huchi in ka lengmang ding a, khamuangtak in ka om ding.
english: I said, “Oh that I had wings like a dove! Then I would fly away, and be at rest.

paite: Ngai in, gamlapi ah ka vialvak dia, gamdai ah ka om ding hi. Selah
english: Behold, then I would wander far off. I would lodge in the wilderness.” Selah.

paite: Huih hattak leh huihpi a kipan ka bukna mun ah ka taikin ding, ka chi a.
english: “I would hurry to a shelter from the stormy wind and storm.”

paite: TOUPA aw, alei uh hihsia in hihkek in; khopi ah ngongtatna leh kisuknatna ka mu ngal a.
english: Confuse them, Lord, and confound their language, for I have seen violence and strife in the city.

paite: Sun leh zan in khopi kulh dawn ah avialvak ua; sung ah thulimlouhna leh haksatna a-om hi.
english: Day and night they prowl around on its walls. Malice and abuse are also within her.

paite: Gitlouh satlouhna asung ah a-om a, nuaisiahna leh khemna in kholak apawtsan ngei kei hi.
english: Destructive forces are within her. Threats and lies don’t depart from her streets.

paite: Hon gensia lah melma ahi ngal kei a; hileh zaw, ka thuak thei zaw ding, ka tung a kihihlian a hon hua ahi sam kei a; hileh zaw, ka buksan ding hi.
english: For it was not an enemy who insulted me, then I could have endured it. Neither was it he who hated me who raised himself up against me, then I would have hidden myself from him.

paite: Himahleh, nang, ka mi batpih, ka lawm, kithuahpih theih na hi ngal a.
english: But it was you, a man like me, my companion, and my familiar friend.

paite: Kam khumtak in i kihoukhawm zel a, mipi lak a Pathian inn ah i pawt zel hi.
english: We took sweet fellowship together. We walked in God’s house with company.

paite: Sihna atung uah hong tung henla, kohawm ah ahing in paisuk uhen; gitlouh satlouhnate a omna uah leh agilsungte uah a-om ngal a.
english: Let death come suddenly on them. Let them go down alive into Sheol. For wickedness is among them, in their dwelling.

paite: Ke'n zaw Pathian ka sam ding a; TOUPA'N hon hondam ding hi.
english: As for me, I will call on God. Yahweh will save me.

paite: Nitaklam, zingsang, sun in ka mangbat thu ka gen in ka thum ding a, huchi in ama'n ka aw angaikhe ding hi.
english: Evening, morning, and at noon, I will cry out in distress. He will hear my voice.

paite: Ka tung a kidouna lak ah ka hinna khamuangtak in ahumbitta a, hon sualte lah atam ngal ua.
english: He has redeemed my soul in peace from the battle that was against me, although there are many who oppose me.

paite: Pathian, nidanglai a om gige in, angaikhe dia, amau adawng ding. Selah Lamdanna nei ngei lou, Pathian laudan siam ngei lou mite zaw.
english: God, who is enthroned forever, will hear and answer them. Selah. They never change and don’t fear God.

paite: Amah toh kituakte tung ah akhut alik a; athukhun abohsia hi.
english: He raises his hands against his friends. He has violated his covenant.

paite: Akam nawituidat bang in anem a, alungtang bel kidouna ahi ngal a; athute sathau sang in analzaw a, himahleh namsau phawisate ahi.
english: His mouth was smooth as butter, but his heart was war. His words were softer than oil, yet they were drawn swords.

paite: TOUPA tung ah na puakgik nga lechin, ama'n nang ahon hihhat ding hi. Midiktat chik mah in leng hihlin aphal kei ding hi.
english: Cast your burden on Yahweh and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.

paite: Himahleh, Pathian aw, nang amaute manthatna kohawm ah na paisuksak ding; sisan suah hat leh khemhat mite tuh adamsung kimkhat uh leng adam zou kei ding uhi; ke'n bel nang ka hon muang hi.
english: But you, God, will bring them down into the pit of destruction. Bloodthirsty and deceitful men shall not live out half their days, but I will trust in you.
